g.text: KRISHI JAL: PRECISION AGRO-HYDROLOGICAL & AI ALERT ARCHITECTURE
End-to-End Field Telemetry, Edge Computing, FAO-56 Water Balance & Multi-Channel Alerting
v3.8.2-PROD
FAO-56 COMPLIANT
1. FIELD INGRESS & SENSING MESH
DATA SOURCES
In-Situ Subterranean Soil Sensors
• Soil Moisture Probe (FDR): 0–100% Volumetric Water Content (VWC)
• Tensiometer Sensor: Soil Matric Potential (0–200 kPa suction)
• Electrical Conductivity & NPK: Subsoil salinity & nutrient profile
• Inline Pulse Flow Meter: Real-time irrigation discharge (m³/hr)
• Soil Horizon Stratum: Topsoil (0-15cm), Root-Zone (15-45cm), Subsoil
• Sampling Frequency: 15-minute telemetry intervals via LoRa SX1278
Precision Aerial UAV & Macro Camera
• Agri Drone (DJI Agras / UAV): Multispectral NDVI crop canopy imaging
• Field Macro Photography: Smartphone camera RGB soil clod samples
• Crop Stress Detection: Canopy temperature depression & chlorophyll index
• Resolution & Downscaling: Client-side 120×120 canvas normalization
• Edge Rejection Pre-check: 8×8 patch directional Sobel gradient filter
• Payload Encoding: Base64 JPEG/PNG multi-part framing over HTTPS
External Agro-Met & Commodity Feeds
• Open-Meteo & IMD API: Solar Rad (Rs MJ/m²), 2m Temp, RH %, Wind u₂
• Forecast Rain Accumulator: 24h/48h precipitation hazard tracking
• AGMARKNET APMC Mandis: Daily modal prices & arrival volume feeds
• Govt Mechanization (SMAM): CHC tractor & implement specifications
• National Soil Taxonomy: Alluvial, Black Cotton, Red Laterite, Sandy Loam
• Sync Cadence: Hourly weather cron with 6h persistent cache fallback
• Offline Climatology: 10-year monthly regional baseline fallback
2. INGESTION, FEATURE ENGINES & AI
PROCESSING
Gateway, Routing & State Persistence
• ThreadingHTTPServer (:8000): Multi-threaded Python REST server
• Vite Reverse Proxy (:5173): Edge middleware, CORS & API proxying
• SQLite3 WAL Mode (krishi_jal.db): Zero-lock high concurrency writes
• Relational Schema: equipment, bookings, soil_tests, produce_listings
• Client Storage Layer: IndexedDB & localStorage offline telemetry queue
• Service Worker (sw.js): Cache-first PWA offline field resilience
AI/ML Model Suite & Speech Services
• MobileNet v2 Edge Tensor: Rejects non-soil objects (vehicles, tech, pets)
• Heuristic Texture Engine: HSV color signature & clod spatial variance
• Gemini 1.5 Flash Vision: Multimodal soil nutrient & compaction scoring
• OpenAI Whisper Large v3: Multilingual STT (Hindi, Punjabi, Telugu, etc.)
• Local Python Whisper Base: Offline speech-to-text fallback engine
• Context-Aware LLM: Grounded agronomic prompts with crop phenology
FAO-56 Hydrological Calculus & Rules Engine
• Penman-Monteith ET₀: Net radiation, vapor pressure deficit & wind
• Crop Evapotranspiration: ETc = Kc × ET₀ (indexed across growth stages)
• Effective Rain (USDA-SCS): Peff = P × (125 - 0.2×P) / 125
• Net & Gross Requirement: NIR = ETc - Peff, GIR = NIR / η_method
• Pumping Duration Engine: t_pump = (GIR × Area) / (Q_pump × 3600)
• Threshold Gate: Wilting point breach when soil depletion > 50% MAD
• Rain Intercept Lock: Auto-suspend irrigation if rain > 10mm forecast
3. OPERATIONS, DASHBOARD & DISPATCH
DISPATCH
High-Fidelity Operations Dashboard (React 18)
• Soil Water Depletion Ring: Visual percentage gauge with stress warning
• Pump Run-Time Counter: Exact hours/minutes needed for replenishment
• Energy Cost Ledger: Grid Electricity (kWh × Tariff) vs Diesel (L/hr)
• Mandi Spread Matrix: 7-day moving average modal rates vs CACP MSP
• Equipment Fleet Map: Haversine GPS proximity matching for CHCs
• Seasonal Crop Stage Roadmap: Phenological irrigation & NPK calendar
Multi-Channel Alerting & Field Actuation
• Farmer Mobile PWA: Instant push notification ("Run Pump: 2h 45m")
• Automated Pump Relay: Direct solenoid trigger via PM-KUSUM SCADA
• Kisan SMS Service: Plain-text regional language SMS for basic handsets
• WhatsApp Business API: Rich advisory cards with local audio notes
• Audible Siren / Trip Alert: On-field buzzer trigger for dry-run protection
• Spray Safety Window Alert: Wind < 12 km/h advisory for drone spraying
Agronomic Artifacts & External Integration
• Soil Health Card (PDF/Canvas): NPK dosing & gypsum/lime remedies
• Water Consumption Ledger (CSV): Verifiable logs for PMFBY insurance
• Voice Narration Stream (/api/tts): Regional speech synthesis stream
• e-NAM & FPO Trade Gateway: Direct mandi lot creation & buyer bidding
• Uber for Farm Machinery: CHC tractor, seeder & drone rental bookings
• Cloud Object Archive (AWS S3): Multi-season soil images & audit trails
• Latency SLA: Local Rules <15ms | STT <850ms | Vision <1600ms

SYSTEM STACK: Open-Meteo REST API • TensorFlow.js MobileNet v2 • OpenAI Whisper Large v3 • Google Gemini 1.5 Flash • SQLite3 WAL Mode • React 18 + Vite
100% PROGRAMMATIC ARCHITECTURE SPECIFICATION
